about.designHeadline:
We design your beauty

in the most scientific way
about.designSub:
RE:BERRY is not a clinic that simply recommends procedures.

Based on objective data and our medical team's experience,

we design care made for one person only.
about.promise1:
We value the time of transformation more than
the moment of the procedure.
Rather than a treatment that ends with a single satisfaction,
we promise results you can trust for a long time.
From the very first diagnosis to aftercare,
we will be with you until the end, for your beauty alone.
about.promise2:
We think of an accurate diagnosis first,
rather than more procedures.
We consider the change you truly need, not just a visible one.
With objective data and our medical team's experience,
we will responsibly design a beauty that is only yours.

home.directorBio:
I listen to each person's story,

and this will be a space that proposes treatments

to bring out their beauty.

From consultation to procedure and aftercare,

I personally and carefully take responsibility for every step.

With sincere care rather than commercial treatment,

I will design your beauty.
home.careText:
Care shaped around each person's skin.

Necessary treatment over trending procedures,

honest consultation over excessive care,

lasting satisfaction over temporary change.

slides: Dedicated 1:1 care by a responsible director

Objective facial diagnosis via LifeBiz AI-based
3D analysis camera

Only at RE:BERRY — scientific care through a
systematic skin-type classification system
Transparent procedures with genuine, precise-dose products
Every step of the procedure, done by the director personally

Systematic aftercare that follows through
on diagnostic data
